name: Secret Network
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.71). Replaced keyword guess "bridge-crosschain".
rootCause: The private public chain Secret Network stated on Twitter that the main network has undergone an unplanned upgrade, from secret-2 to secret-3, to prevent major network security issues from causing financial losses. The team stated that neither the native token SCRT nor the cross-chain bridge contract were affected. Only a single smart contract was affected. The contract came from SecretSwap. A vulnerability was exploited, allowing the attacker to take away the pledged SEFI contract. funds. At present, the cross-chain bridge is still closed, and the deposit function of the exchange is also closed.
